title: Meet Mere Man Ke
desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man from high society, falls in love with a courtesan, Jyoti, after she saves his life. However, the gulf in social status of the two prevents them from being together.

title: Bhakti Mein Shakti
desc: Akbar, the powerful Mughal emperor, travels barefoot to the Hindu goddess Sherawali Mata's temple, seeking to foster unity between Hindus and Muslims.

title: Zorro
desc: When some of the king's officers begin terrorising the people of the kingdom for money, a masked vigilante rises to protect the innocent villagers.

title: Tulsi
desc: Tulsi wants to marry Ganesh, but her father does not agree. Meanwhile, when the village matchmakers arrange for her marriage with Thakur Singh, she strives to marry the person of her choice.

title: Divorce
desc: Ajay goes against the will of his parents and gets married to Seema. However, later, his life changes when he sees her with another man and blames her for committing infidelity.

title: Param Dharam
desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.
